title: Support case draft (team artifact)
description: Redacted support and moderation case drafts from the Support Desk preview. Only the human replies or acts. Created by @meta_alchemist (https://x.com/meta_alchemist).

version.description: Artifact schema version the producer wrote. Same major as x-version.

id.description: Template id, or owner for files the owner makes.

createdAt.description: UTC time the file was written.

synthetic.description: True for worked examples. Consumers never treat synthetic data as a measurement.

build.description: The build the items describe, when they describe one.

caseRef.description: Local case label, never a player id.

topic.description: Topic, for example bug, purchase, conduct.

subject.description: Hashed subject id (sub_ plus 32 hex), when needed.

routeTo.description: Template that should see it, for example 18 or 24.
